installer.database_backend_tested: isolated SQLite application with actual Laravel migrations
checks: Accepts the reported previous route version and missing additions
Rejects unexpected server code changes before copying
Rejects corrupted package contents before copying
Performs deployment and creates code and database backups
Database backup retains the pre-migration schema and existing media rows
Migration assigns distinct aliases to duplicate media filenames
Code restore returns previous file bytes and previous maintenance state
Code restore retains existing data and the additive database column
Repeat installation preserves previously assigned media aliases

limitations: Targeted application regression checks, not the entire project test suite
MySQL/MariaDB backup connectivity was not tested against the hosting server; backup failure stops before payload copying
Server reports contain file hashes rather than source contents; application files in FILES.txt replace hosting versions after backup
Browser verification on the hosting server remains to be done after installation
